metas.name: The Mortician
metas.description: A family funeral home in 1980s Pasadena, under David Sconce's leadership, betrayed public trust by exploiting bereaved families and the deceased through unethical practices to maximize profits.

metas.name: The Better Sister
metas.description: Two estranged sisters, Chloe (Jessica Biel) and Nicky (Elizabeth Banks), one married to and the other divorced from the same man, Adam (Corey Stoll), are forced together after he is murdered.

metas.name: Mad Unicorn
metas.description: Giving up his street life, a young man breaks new ground with the launch of a startup business that brings new opportunities and powerful enemies.

metas.name: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
metas.description: It explores 1980s Chicago deaths from cyanide-laced Tylenol capsules. The case led to tamper-proof packaging and became one of America's largest criminal investigations.

metas.name: Our Unwritten Seoul
metas.description: Identical twin sisters with opposite lives - one a former athlete living freely, the other a corporate perfectionist switch places with each other, despite their contrasting personalities.

metas.name: Pee-wee as Himself
metas.description: A kaleidoscopic portrait told in two parts that traces the life of the imaginative artist.

metas.name: Sirens
metas.description: Devon is concerned about her sister's unhealthy relationship with her new boss.

metas.name: Nine Puzzles
metas.description: Jo I-na finds her uncle murdered beside a puzzle piece but can't explain her presence. Ten years later, as a criminal profiler, she investigates murders where victims are found with similar puzzle pieces.

metas.name: Motorheads
metas.description: A group of outsiders in a once-thriving Rust Belt town form an unlikely friendship over a mutual love of automobiles.

metas.name: Duster
metas.description: Set in the 1970s Southwest, the life of a gutsy getaway driver for a growing crime syndicate goes from awful to wildly, stupidly, dangerously awful.

metas.name: Secrets We Keep
metas.description: When her neighbor's au pair goes missing, Cecilie is compelled to personally investigate but as she uncovers the truth, her perfect world falls apart.

metas.name: American Manhunt: Osama Bin Laden
metas.description: An in-depth look at how the world mobilized to hunt down Osama bin Laden after his orchestrations of the September 11th, 2001 attacks on the United States.

metas.name: Fred & Rose West: A British Horror Story
metas.description: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts tell the story of Fred and Rose West, two of the UK's most prolific murderers.

metas.name: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
metas.description: Follows the galaxy's criminal underworld. Asajj Ventress, a former assassin, flees with a new ally, while Cad Bane confronts his past when meeting an old friend turned Marshal.

metas.name: Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
metas.description: When the druid Getafix forgets how to prepare the magic potion, Asterix and Obelix must defend the village as Caesar plots to use a Gallic law against them.

metas.name: Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes
metas.description: Police pursue suspects in failed bombing attempts. Innocent Brazilian man is misidentified as a suspect and shot dead by police. Police are found guilty in his death. Police Commissioner resigns.

metas.name: Étoile
metas.description: The dancers and artistic staff of two world-renowned ballet companies embark on an ambitious gambit to save their storied institutions by swapping their most talented stars.

metas.name: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
metas.description: Burma Railway in 1943 and across the Pacific during World War II, charts the cruelty of war, the tenuousness of life and the impossibility of love, as seen through the eyes of an Australian doctor and prisoner of war.

metas.name: The Diamond Heist
metas.description: In 2000, a group of London criminals plan an audacious heist: ram-raid the Millennium Dome, steal diamond and escape by boat on the Thames, but the police are surveilling them.

metas.name: Towards Zero
metas.description: Inspector Leach probes the brutal murder of an elderly widow in her Gull's Point home. A failed suicide, a false theft charge, an out-of-service hotel lift and a tennis star's love life intersect, culminating in a bizarre mass mur...

metas.name: The Glass Dome
metas.description: A criminologist and her former police chief partner investigate the vanishing of a local girl in the small Swedish town where she was once held captive.

metas.name: Resident Playbook
metas.description: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

metas.name: The Gardener
metas.description: Elmer and his controlling mother La China Jurado have a contract killing business. Emotionless after an accident, Elmer falls for Violeta, a teacher he's hired to kill. He must learn to love while his mother tries to eliminate Vio...

metas.name: Bad Influence: The Dark Side of Kidfluencing
metas.description: A revealing look into YouTube star Piper Rockelle's world, her relationship with her manager-mother Tiffany Smith, and the untold stories of past collaborators who were part of her content-creating team.

metas.name: Dying for Sex
metas.description: Story of a woman diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer, who abandons her husband of 15 years and begins to fully explore her sexuality.

metas.name: Karma
metas.description: Bound by their harrowing destinies, a physician plagued by nightmares, a man shaken after his world was unexpectedly disrupted and a debtor drowning in private loans become caught in inescapable circumstances.

metas.name: The Bondsman
metas.description: Resurrected bounty hunter Hub Halloran gets an unexpected second chance at life, love and his nearly forgotten musical career--only to find that his old job now has a demonic new twist.

metas.name: Pulse
metas.description: Follows the personal and professional lives of doctors and staff at a busy Miami trauma center.

metas.name: Mid-Century Modern
metas.description: After an unexpected death, three best friends--gay gentlemen of a certain age--decide to spend their golden years living together in Palm Springs, where the wealthiest one lives with his mother.

metas.name: Caught
metas.description: In Bariloche, reporter Ema Garay's online exposes unveil tax dodgers. Her probe into a 16-year-old's disappearance points to Leo Mercer, upending both their lives.

metas.name: The Residence
metas.description: Inside the White House's staff residence and the lives which workers share with the First Family.

metas.name: Dope Thief
metas.description: Follows long-time friends and delinquents who pose as DEA agents to rob a house in the countryside, but end up unintentionally revealing and unraveling the biggest hidden narcotics corridor on the Eastern seaboard.

metas.name: Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: Long Bright River
metas.description: A Philadelphia police officer searches for her sister, an addict who has gone missing.

metas.name: The Leopard
metas.description: A 19th-century Sicilian aristocratic family gets caught up in the changing sociopolitical times.

metas.name: Just One Look
metas.description: Greta's life unravels when an old photo shows her husband and others, one with a crossed-out face. Greta searches for him, realizing he's been kidnapped while her kids are threatened. The truth leads back to Greta's past trauma.

metas.name: Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue
metas.description: A plane carrying ten people crashes into the Mexican jungle, leaving them stranded. As they are murdered one by one, the remaining survivors must solve the mystery of who is killing them.

metas.name: Toxic Town
metas.description: When dozens of babies in Corby are born with disabilities, their mothers embark on a battle to hold those responsible to account.

metas.name: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke
metas.description: Follows Ruby Franke, a former YouTube mom blogger with millions of followers who was sentenced to prison for child abuse.

metas.name: Grosse Pointe Garden Society
metas.description: Four members of a suburban garden club get caught up in murder and mischief as they strive to flourish.

metas.name: Zero Day
metas.description: In the midst of crisis, how can we discover the truth when it seems the world is being destroyed by uncontrollable forces? And to what extent are conspiracy theories our own inventions or products of our imagination?

metas.name: Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: Good Cop/Bad Cop
metas.description: Siblings working as detectives in a small town navigate quirky locals, limited resources, their strained relationship, and their father, who's the police chief, in this comedic crime procedural.

metas.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
metas.description: The life of wellness guru Belle Gibson, who had a large social media following, where she pretended to be suffering from cancer but keeping the disease under control using self-care therapies. She confessed that none of it was true.

metas.name: Cassandra
metas.description: Germany's oldest smart home awakens its AI helper Cassandra after decades when a new family moves in. Cassandra, determined never to be abandoned again, manipulates events using the home's resources to become part of the family.

metas.name: American Primeval
metas.description: It follows the gritty and adventurous exploration of the birth of the American West, the violent collisions of cults, religion, and men and women fighting for control of the new world.

metas.name: Missing You
metas.description: Detective Kat Donovan's world unravels when she finds her estranged fiancé on a dating app. Leading her to reopen her father's unsolved murder.
